title: Filed Minimum-Earned Percents by Payment Plan
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the minimum-earned percent of a coverage return follows the payment plan billing the owner term the coverage belongs to. These are the company's filed minimum-earned percents by payment plan, read from the owner term's Installment Payment Plans record:
- **Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan:** the paid-in-full minimum-earned percent of 5 percent.
- **Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan:** the autopay minimum-earned percent of 8 percent.
- **Any other plan** (the Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan, Four-Pay Plan or Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan): the standard minimum-earned percent of 10 percent.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a full-term rate of 1,260.00 USD, the minimum-earned percent comes to:
- 63.00 USD on the Paid-in-Full Plan;
- 100.80 USD on the Monthly EFT Plan;
- 126.00 USD on the Four-Pay Plan.
